BiblicalUsage: Bezek means lightning, and it is the rallying ground of two different wars. Judges 1:4 says Judah slew ten thousand in Bezek, and Judges 1:5 says they found Adoni-bezek there, the lord of the town. Later, 1 Samuel 11:8 says Saul numbered Israel in Bezek before marching to save Jabesh — three hundred thousand men, counted at Bezek.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bezek is where Israel learned to count its strength: first in battle, then in muster, and both times the Lord delivered.
